name: WayriCAD Bulk Label Editor
description: Bulk edit labels, PCB text, footprint references, values, and fields with wildcard or regex rules.
description_full: WayriCAD Bulk Label Editor provides a safe preview-and-apply workflow for renaming repeated channel labels and component text inside KiCad. It supports wildcard captures such as CH*_MAIN -> CH*_REDUNDANT, regex replacements, and scoped edits for references, values, fields, and PCB text.
